messages:
pat_support: Urgent escalation  Trial org 'opticlass-trial-4' can't complete onboarding - invites accepted but users remain in 'pending' state. Customer has a training session tomorrow; marking high priority for renewal.

pat_support: log excerpt:
```text
[2026-04-02T16:11:22Z] INVITE_FLOW org=opticlass-trial-4 user=instructor@opticlass.edu status=ACCEPTED -> PENDING_PROVISION
```

infra_bot: Incident created: INC-2059-780; severity=high; routed to eng-platform.

leah_cs: I'll own comms. Who pushed the quota/config change earlier today? Need list of affected orgs and POCs. Renewal touch scheduled Friday; if we don't unblock, risk rises. @andre_prod any quick hypotheses?

pat_support: Affected orgs: opticlass-trial-4, opticlass-pilot-1. Reporter: instructor@opticlass.edu. We saw a config rollout at 14:30 UTC that introduced stricter provisioning rate limits. Attached support ticket ST-11730.

andre_prod: Confirmed: rollout changed provisioning throttle defaults to protect backend under load (new default: max_concurrent_provisions=2 for trials). That is too conservative for some classroom demos. Options: (1) temporarily increase per-org limit, (2) disable throttle for these orgs, (3) schedule an emergency rollback of the rollout. Quick per-org command to bump limit:
```bash
redwood-admin org-config set --org opticlass-trial-4 --key max_concurrent_provisions --value 20
```
I can apply (1) immediately if support signs off. We'll follow up with a policy tweak for trial profiles.

jules_am: Please apply the bump. We need the classroom demo and the renewal conversation intact. I'll draft a note: apologise, confirm temporary bump, propose a 15-min validation before their session, and offer a one-week trial extension if they want extra time. Will update SFDC.

pat_support: Created CR-10123 to authorize per-org bump. Also added renewal flag in SFDC for instructor@opticlass.edu.

andre_prod: Applied `max_concurrent_provisions=20` to both orgs. Retried pending provisions -> provisioning completed, users now active. Verified UI shows roster and access.

leah_cs: Draft comms (short): 1) apology + cause (new throttle default blocked rapid onboarding) 2) confirm we've applied a temporary per-org uplift and invites now work 3) propose 15-min validation call before training 4) next steps: product will update trial provisioning policy and we'll share ETA. Sending to @jules_am for AM tone.

jules_am: Sent customer note and scheduled 08:30 PT validation call. Also added a renewal-friendly line offering a complimentary one-week extension.

pat_support: Support will keep ST-11730 open until the policy update is live. Monitoring hooks added to provisioning-throttle stream.

infra_bot: Incident INC-2059-780 status -> mitigated; action TASK-5564 created: "review trial provisioning defaults and add telemetry".

leah_cs: Recap owners: CS comms + validation call (leah_cs), AM renewal framing (jules_am), Eng adjust policy + follow-up (andre_prod), Support monitoring + ticket (pat_support). :white_check_mark:
